description: Complete military aviation and artillery suite for Minecraft Forge 1.12.2

items.name: Wood Biplane
items.desc: Lightweight open-cockpit wooden biplane with responsive low-speed handling and dual forward machine guns. Ideal for reconnaissance, short-field bush landings, and early aerial scouting.
items.recipe: Oak Planks (x6), Iron Ingot (x2), Stick (x4), String (x2), Propeller Blade (x2)
items.controls: W/S: Throttle Up/Down | A/D: Roll (Bank) | Up/Down Arrows: Pitch | Space: Fire MGs | V: Tactical HUD | R: Cycle Weapon

items.name: Iron Monoplane
items.desc: All-metal cantilever monoplane equipped with an enclosed cockpit windscreen, streamlined radial engine cowling, and dual bomb racks. Excellent climb rate and high-altitude dive capability.
items.recipe: Iron Plates (x12), Iron Engine (x1), Glass Panes (x2), Iron Bomb Racks (x2)
items.controls: W/S: Throttle | A/D: Roll | Arrows: Pitch | Space: Fire Selected Weapon | R: Cycle (Guns / Bombs)

items.name: Fighter Jet
items.desc: Next-generation swept-wing air superiority fighter powered by dual afterburning turbofans. Emits a supersonic vapor cone and shockwave upon breaching 160 blocks/s. Features active radar lock HUD and flare countermeasures.
items.recipe: Titanium Alloy (x16), Afterburning Jet Turbine (x2), Avionics Circuit (x1), Rotary Cannon Core (x1)
items.controls: W/S: Throttle / Afterburner | Space: Fire Vulcan / Missiles | V: Radar HUD Lock | F: Deploy Flares

items.name: Stealth Bomber
weapons: Internal Rotary Bomb Bay (12x Heavy, EMP, or Cluster Bombs)
items.desc: Matte radar-absorbent flying wing with serrated trailing edges and internal payload bays. Completely untargetable by radar-guided AA batteries, SAM sites, and heat-seeking MANPADS unless bomb bay doors are open.
items.recipe: Radar Absorbent Composite (x24), Dual Quad Turbofans (x2), Heavy Rotary Bay Assembly (x1)
items.controls: W/S: Cruise Throttle | Space: Salvo Bomb Drop | B: Open/Close Bomb Bay Doors | V: Thermal Bomb Sight

items.name: Predator Drone (UAV)
weapons: EO/IR Gimbal Surveillance Camera (4x Optical Zoom)
items.desc: Remotely operated drone aircraft controlled from the ground using a Drone Terminal. Features high-aspect glider wings for extreme endurance, nose satellite dome, and stabilized optical zoom camera targeting.
items.recipe: Lightweight Aluminum (x8), Satellite Uplink Card (x1), Rotax Engine (x1), Camera Gimbal (x1)
items.controls: Right-click Drone Controller item to link and assume remote FPV control from anywhere within 512 blocks.

items.name: Attack Helicopter
items.desc: Twin-turboshaft tandem attack gunship capable of stationary hovering, sideways strafing maneuvers, and devastating saturation rocket attacks. Generates realistic rotor downwash particles.
items.recipe: Hardened Steel Plates (x14), Dual Turboshaft Transmission (x1), Rotor Swashplate (x1), Stub Wing Racks (x2)
items.controls: W/S: Forward/Backward | Q/E: Lateral Strafe Left/Right | Space/Shift: Collective Climb/Descend | Left-Click: Fire

items.name: Main Battle Tank
items.desc: Heavy armored tracked combat vehicle. The rotating turret tracks player aim and fires high-velocity APFSDS kinetic rounds with flat ballistic trajectories that ignore standard player armor reduction.
items.recipe: Composite Chobham Armor (x18), Diesel V12 Engine (x1), 120mm Gun Barrel (x1), Caterpillar Tracks (x2)
items.controls: W/S: Drive Tracks | A/D: Pivot Hull | Mouse: Aim 360° Turret | Left-Click: Fire 120mm Cannon

items.name: Missile Command Truck
weapons: Dual Elevated Long-Range Missile Launch Cells (Truck Guided Missiles)
items.desc: 6x6 tactical all-terrain armored truck equipped with dual hydraulically raised missile launch tubes. The player can drive the vehicle, deploy the outriggers, and guide supersonic cruise missiles into enemy bases.
items.recipe: Heavy Truck Chassis (x1), 6x6 Offroad Tires (x6), Hydraulic Launch Piston (x2), Targeting Radar (x1)
items.controls: Drive into position, press X to lock stabilizers, press Space to launch missile and assume missile-cam guidance.

items.name: Armored Patrol Truck
weapons: Roof Cupola Heavy Machine Gun (Heavy Rounds, AP-20)
items.desc: Armored troop carrier with reinforced front ramming bullbar and 360-degree rotating machine gun cupola. Spawns in convoy patrols across desert and plains biomes.
items.recipe: Steel Plate Chassis (x10), Heavy All-Terrain Tires (x6), Machine Gun Turret Ring (x1)
items.controls: Driver controls vehicle; secondary passenger operates the 360-degree high-angle machine gun cupola.

items.name: AGM-114 Hellfire
items.desc: Precision anti-armor missile. Tracks targets designated by an active Laser Designator beam, executing top-attack dive profiles against enemy tanks and fortifications.

items.name: BrahMos Cruise Missile
items.desc: Devastating supersonic cruise missile. Climbs to high altitude, navigates to coordinates specified by the BrahMos Targeter GPS card, and conducts a hypersonic terminal dive.

items.name: Predator TV Missile
items.desc: Fired from aircraft or Predator Drones. Switches player perspective directly into the missile nose camera, allowing manually steered precision flight into windows or bunkers.

items.name: FIM-92 MANPADS Missile
items.desc: Infrared homing surface-to-air missile fired from the portable MANPADS launcher. Emits a continuous lock-on tone when aimed at enemy aircraft engines.

items.name: Truck Guided Missile
items.desc: Heavy missile launched from the Missile Command Truck. Features solid rocket booster stage and mid-course radio guidance.

items.name: 227mm MLRS Rocket
items.desc: Unguided spin-stabilized artillery rocket fired in continuous salvos of 12 from MLRS launch pads to blanket enemy strongpoints.

items.name: Iron Bomb
items.desc: General-purpose high explosive iron bomb with cruciform tail fins. Arcs naturally with inherited plane velocity upon release.

items.name: Heavy Blockbuster Bomb
items.desc: 1,000kg high-capacity demolition bomb featuring a circular tail shroud ring. Obliterates stone structures and reinforced bunkers.

items.name: Napalm Canister
items.desc: Jellied fuel incendiary bomb that bursts into a sprawling sea of persistent fire, denying ground movement for 60 seconds.

items.name: Cluster Dispenser
items.desc: Clamshell dispenser canister that splits open mid-fall, scattering 12 bouncing fragmentation bomblets across a wide perimeter.

items.name: EMP Pulse Bomb
items.desc: High-tech electromagnetic pulse bomb. Emits cyan energy shockwave upon detonation, cutting airplane engines, disabling HUDs, and resetting redstone repeaters.

items.name: Fuel-Air Thermobaric Bomb
items.desc: Thermobaric weapon dispersing a vapor aerosol cloud ignited by a secondary burster charge, generating immense shockwave overpressure.

items.name: Naval Depth Charge
items.desc: Hydrostatic drum bomb designed to sink rapidly through water and detonate at preset depths, destroying submerged vessels.

items.name: Tactical Smoke Screen Bomb
items.desc: Vented smoke canister generating a thick opaque smoke cloud that breaks laser targeting locks and obscures line-of-sight.

items.name: AA Autocannon
items.desc: Twin 20mm rapid-fire anti-aircraft autocannon. Swivels automatically to lead aerial targets and discharges high-speed flat tracer rounds.

items.name: 88mm Flak Battery
items.desc: Heavy flak artillery firing high-altitude timed shells that detonate into lethal shrapnel clouds, tearing wings off high-flying bombers.

items.name: 155mm Field Howitzer
items.desc: Long-range indirect artillery cannon. Features adjustable azimuth and elevation angles to bombard target coordinates over mountains and hills.

items.name: MLRS Emplacement
items.desc: Multiple Launch Rocket System pod mounted on a fortified swivel base. Fires rapid 12-round rocket barrages.

items.name: Static Missile Silo Battery
items.desc: Fortified vertical launch missile silo that automatically tracks and intercepts incoming enemy planes and cruise missiles.

items.name: Orbital Cannon Multiblock Core
items.desc: Massive 3x3 multiblock structure. Once charged with redstone energy and designated with the Orbital Designator, calls down a hypervelocity Tungsten Rod from orbit causing dimensional screen-shake and total cratering.

items.name: 20mm Machine Gun Bullet
items.desc: High-velocity copper-jacketed machine gun projectile with visible golden tracer trail and aerodynamic physics.

items.name: AA Tracer Round
items.desc: Anti-aircraft incendiary tracer shell with bright yellow-orange flight trace, specifically tuned to damage aircraft engines.

items.name: 88mm Flak Airburst Shell
items.desc: Time-fuzed artillery shell with mechanical clockwork detonator that bursts into a cloud of sharp steel fragments.

items.name: 60mm Mortar Shell
items.desc: Teardrop aerodynamic mortar shell with tail boom stabilizing fins, designed for high-angle lobbed ballistic trajectories.

items.name: 155mm Howitzer Shell
items.desc: Heavy 155mm artillery projectile with copper rifling driving band and pointed ogive impact/proximity fuze.

items.name: 120mm APFSDS Kinetic Dart
items.desc: Armour-Piercing Fin-Stabilized Discarding Sabot long-rod penetrator dart designed to punch through the thickest vehicle armor.
